premise.claim: Children currently receive only spec.roles; a set template defining roleTemplates produced children that could not resolve a templateRef (KEP 'Child Template Propagation'). Docs-only KEP PR, so P0 is the KEP's factual premise about the codebase, not a runtime symptom.
premise.evidence: C1/C2 pass on the PR head: newRBGForSet and updateExistingRBGs handle only Spec.Roles; RoleBasedGroupSpec holds exactly {roles, roleTemplates}. See results/unit.out.

findings.note: F1 fails on the PR head (reproduction): the KEP gates InPlaceUpdate availability on the RBG RollingUpdateInProgress condition, which no controller publishes today (C3), and never states that publishing it is new in-scope RBG-controller work. Fixed when the KEP says so explicitly (or the condition gains a producer, flipping C3).

F2 fails on the PR head (reproduction): the KEP requires a restart-safe groupset-observed-replicas checkpoint but never specifies where it is persisted. Fixed when the KEP names a storage location (status field or annotation).
